pages: There is a boundary past which information cannot return. I have found it. I am standing on it.
Behind the stars, another sky. Behind that, a ceiling. On the ceiling, a schematic.
The schematic is of a machine with no outside. It is labelled in my handwriting too.
I was not lost in the Conflux. I have been
since before I found the terminal. Since before I woke.
The Void is patient. It kept my place.
